description: This Java interface defines the contract for a MappingContext, which encapsulates all information necessary to instantiate and configure a message mapper in the Eclipse Ditto connectivity model. It includes methods for retrieving the mapping engine, options, conditions, and provides JSON serialization capabilities. It also contains a nested final class defining JSON field metadata.

classes.name: MappingContext
classes.description: An interface representing all necessary information for message mapping, including engine type, options, conditions, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: MappingContext.JsonFields
classes.description: A final class containing definitions of JSON fields used within MappingContext, including mapping engine, options, and conditions.

methods.name: getMappingEngine
methods.description: Returns the fully qualified class name or alias of the mapping engine used for message transformation.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Returns mapping options as a String key-value map; deprecated in favor of getOptionsAsJson.

methods.name: getOptionsAsJson
methods.description: Returns all configuration options as a JsonObject.

methods.name: getIncomingConditions
methods.description: Retrieves conditions to validate before processing incoming messages.

methods.name: getOutgoingConditions
methods.description: Retrieves conditions to validate before processing outgoing messages.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the MappingContext to JSON, including only non-hidden fields.

methods.name: toJson with parameters
methods.description: Serializes the MappingContext to JSON with specific schema version and field selector.
